perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique: [D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The delivered contribution is the exact compatible-full-law optimization, binary garbling and scalar reduction, strict separation from the explicitly defined box-augmented relaxation, and conditional regular-region inference; the basic feasibility iff is largely definitional once attainment is established. The inference result does not deliver the tangent/bootstrap procedure introduced in the definitions and remains confined to a uniformly Slater-regular region whose nonemptiness and empirical checkability are not demonstrated for the proposed application. The Ishikawa–He–Kanamori comparison is correctly only against the note-defined box-augmented specialization, so it does not establish a gap relative to their full published class. No NHANES or other substantive application is delivered, limiting the demonstrated econometric importance and keeping the projected leading-journal score below the strongest field contributions. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.1 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
